messages:
sara: Quick sync — we need to lock acceptance criteria for the graceful-fallback matrix before canary next Tue. Canary rollout planned for 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Who can review edge cases now?
chen: Link the PRD? I'll skim.
sara: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/graceful-fallback-matrix — see section 3 (acceptance) and 4 (canary policy)
omar: Need to call out per-tenant error budgets. Proposal: Gold customers get isolated fallback route (dedicated warm cache) and higher error budget. Bronze gets degraded responses earlier.
linda: Draft acceptance criteria below — pls comment. ```
AC1: P95 latency <= 120ms for Gold, <= 250ms for Standard under 95th pct load.
AC2: Error rate (5xx) increase <= 0.5% absolute on canary vs baseline.
AC3: When model fallback used, response includes metadata field "fallback":true and user-visible quality warning.
AC4: Auto-rollback if error-budget burn >50% in 30m or sustained P95 > 2x target for 15m.
Edgecases: stale cache convergence, partial KV corruption, multi-region split-brain.
```
matt: On rollback triggers — also add token-cost regression check. If tokens-per-response increases by >30% vs baseline, fail canary.
ryan: Observability — need eval prompts to run continuously during canary to detect semantic regressions. Suggest 500 synthetic prompts + 50 held-out customer prompts. Alert if semantic score drops >5%.
omar: Customer tiering note: for Gold, fallback must prefer degraded model (smaller quantized) over empty response. For free tier, returning 503 acceptable if cache miss.
chen: Minor: ensure API contract stays 200 for degraded content (so frontends don't treat as error) but include header X-Redwood-Degraded: 1
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary-rollout/graceful-fallback starting 2026-03-24T14:00Z — 5% traffic for 2h -> 25% for 6h -> 100% over remaining window. Monitoring hooks attached.
sara: Thanks. Quick decision needed: Accept Linda's AC + Matt's cost check + Ryan's evals. If no objections by EOD today I'll mark PRD approved and trigger canary. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
linda: +1 :thumbsup:
matt: +1
omar: +1 but add note to ops runbook about cache priming.
ryan: +1 — I'll add the eval harness to the canary pipeline.
chen: LGTM
sara: I'll update the doc and ping infra to schedule the jobs. tagging @oncall for visibility in case of rollback.
